derivation: from a compound of the base of G3357 (μετρίως) and G3806 (πάθος);
def: to be moderate in passion, i.e. gentle (to treat indulgently)

occurrences.text: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
